Partnership Categories

Ways To Partner

Choose the model that fits your business.

Whether you sell at the counter, cover a territory, or build your own brand, there's a route in. Commercial terms — pricing, margins and minimum order quantities — are confirmed during onboarding based on your model and volume.

D
Territory-based

Distributor / Stockist

Appointed coverage for a district or region, trade margins on OTC lines, and priority dispatch. Ideal for established pharma distributors.

F
Brand-led

Franchise / Super-Stockist

Exclusive rights across a larger territory with sub-stockist appointment support and marketing collateral for the Rose Laboratories range.

P
Your brand

Private Label / OEM

License any of 93 existing formulations or commission a custom formulation, manufactured to WHO-GMP standards under your own label.

I
Bulk supply

Institutional / Export

Hospitals, clinics, government programs and export buyers — bulk supply with full compliance documentation for tenders and due diligence.

How Onboarding Works

From enquiry to first order in four steps.

01

Submit your enquiry

Tell us your business type, territory and the lines you're interested in using the form below. No account needed.

02

Discovery call

Our team reviews your requirement and shares indicative pricing, trade margins and minimum order quantities for your model.

03

Documentation & agreement

Drug licence, GST and KYC verification, followed by a partnership agreement outlining territory and terms.

04

First dispatch

Onboarding to our order channel, product training material, and your first order dispatched from Fatuha, Patna.
